comment: The curated suggested-model list shown in Model management before searching. format 'ggml'/'gguf' entries are runnable by the whisper.cpp engine (Metal-accelerated on Apple Silicon) and download from https://huggingface.co/<repo>/resolve/main/<file>. format 'mlx' entries have no GGML build and are shown greyed out until the app grows an MLX engine.

models.name: whisper-large-v3
models.note: GGML build of whisper-large-v3 — runs on Metal GPU

models.name: parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3
models.note: MLX only — no GGML build, needs an MLX engine

models.note: MLX research code — no GGML build, needs an MLX engine
